BSE200 34.2 1.9 -2.7 CTE 193.9 129.6 67.1 Accelerating Growth and Margin Upside Support Valuation Upgrade Centum Electronics (CTE) delivered a strong Q2FY27 performance, with revenue growing 59% YoY to INR 3,118 Mn and PAT increasing 52% YoY to INR 229 Mn.
Growth was driven by strong execution across both BTS and EMS businesses, while the order book grew 38% YoY to ~INR 2,000 Cr (2.1x of FY26 revenue), providing healthy revenue visibility.

We believe the BTS business is gaining traction, supported by repeat orders for tactical air navigation systems, satellite payload electronics and a ~INR 300 Mn export order for advanced electronic warfare subsystems.

View & Valuation: We remain constructive on Centum’s medium-term growth outlook, supported by a rising order book, a strong order pipeline and increasing traction across defence, space and semiconductor applications.
The management remains confident of sustaining 25–30% medium-term revenue growth, with EBITDA margin targeted at 12.5–13% and potential for further improvement over the coming years.
